# Resume Builder Artifacts

This folder contains generated outputs produced by the resume-building workflow.

## Contents

Expected generated outputs include:

* JSON export files
* scored data artifacts
* intermediate resume drafts
* rendered PDFs and DOCX files

## Policy

* Do not edit files in this directory manually.
* Treat these files as output from notebook or script execution.
* If you want to preserve a previous run, copy it to `../archive/`.
